mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BBS_SURVEY (SRVY_QITEM, CO_SN, COHORT_SN, SRVY_BGNG_DT, SRVY_END_DT, USER_SN, SRVY_TYPE) VALUES (#{srvyQitem}, #{coSn}, #{cohortSn}, #{srvyBgngDt}, #{srvyEndDt}, #{userSn}, #{type})
mapper.select: SELECT S.SRVY_SN, S.SRVY_QITEM, S.CO_SN, S.COHORT_SN, S.SRVY_BGNG_DT, S.SRVY_END_DT, U.USER_NM, S.SRVY_TYPE AS type FROM TB_BBS_SURVEY S LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON S.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE S.SRVY_SN = #{srvySn}

SELECT S.SRVY_SN, S.SRVY_QITEM, S.CO_SN, S.COHORT_SN, S.SRVY_BGNG_DT, S.SRVY_END_DT, U.USER_NM, S.SRVY_TYPE AS type FROM TB_BBS_SURVEY S LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON S.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE S.CO_SN = #{coSn}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BBS_SURVEY SET SRVY_QITEM = #{dto.srvyQitem}, COHORT_SN = #{dto.cohortSn}, SRVY_BGNG_DT = #{dto.srvyBgngDt}, SRVY_END_DT = #{dto.srvyEndDt}, SRVY_TYPE = #{dto.type} WHERE SRVY_SN = #{id}
